Changes.note: The video you pick goes from your browser straight to Medaris's Bunny video library. As soon as tedrisat creates the video it becomes the session's recording and Ders kayıtları says “Hazırlanıyor”; a link or another video the recording held leaves it at that moment. The old link stays only in the audit log; the old video is deleted from Bunny for good once the new upload is over. When Bunny has encoded the video the recording is ready: the enrolled talebe and the course team watch it on the watch page, talebe only from the release time if one was chosen, and when it opens to talebe the enrolled talebe get one “Kayıt eklendi” notification. A stopped upload can be continued within 24 hours, in the same browser with the same file; if that time runs out or Bunny cannot encode the video, the recording drops and the session shows “Kayıt yok” again. If you changed the release time, it is written before the upload and stays changed even when the upload is refused.
Recordings.errors.exists: This session already has a recording; edit it. The page is reloading.
Recordings.errors.gone: This session or recording is no longer there. The page is reloading.
Recordings.release.failed: Recording access could not be saved
Recordings.release.legend: When talebe may watch the recording
Recordings.release.ready: As soon as it is ready
Recordings.title: Course recordings
Recordings.upload.aborted: The upload was stopped. Bunny keeps what it received; continue where it stopped with “Continue”.
Recordings.upload.doneBody: Bunny is processing the video of {session}; it says “Ready” once it is.
Recordings.upload.errors.closed: This upload can no longer be continued. The page is reloading.
Recordings.upload.errors.expired: The upload's 24 hours have passed; it cannot be continued. The recording drops off shortly, and then you can upload the session's video again.
Recordings.upload.errors.failed: The video could not be sent. Try again with “Continue”, from where it stopped.
Recordings.upload.errors.network: The connection dropped. Check your internet connection and continue where it stopped with “Continue”.
Recordings.upload.errors.notConfigured: The video library is not set up. Paste the recording's link for now.
Recordings.upload.errors.notFound: No unfinished upload of this file was found in this browser. Pick the same file in the browser you started the upload in.
Recordings.upload.errors.refused: Bunny did not accept the upload. Try again with “Continue”.
Recordings.upload.errors.size: The file is over the {max} limit. Compress the recording and try again.
Recordings.upload.errors.type: This is not a video file. Pick a video file.
Recordings.upload.errors.unavailable: Bunny is not answering right now. Try again in a little while.
Recordings.upload.failedTitle: The video could not be uploaded
Recordings.upload.fileHelp: At most {max}. If the connection drops, the upload continues where it stopped.
Recordings.upload.note: Upload a session's video to the Medaris video library (Bunny) from here; the file goes from your browser straight to Bunny. While the video is being processed the session says “Processing”, and the page reloads by itself until it is ready.
Recordings.upload.replacesLink: The video you upload replaces this recording's link. Once the upload starts, the link is removed from the recording.
Recordings.upload.replacesVideo: The video you upload replaces this recording's current video. Once the upload starts, the current video is removed from the recording; once the upload is over, it is deleted from Bunny.
Recordings.upload.resumeHelp: If the upload stopped halfway, pick the same file again in the browser you started it in; it continues where it stopped. If the upload finished, Bunny is processing the video and there is nothing to do.
Recordings.upload.stopsUpload: If this recording's upload is still under way, it stops.
